name: dsh-canvas-konva-vendor
description: Build inputs for the vendored Konva surface shipped inside dsh-canvas (lib/vendor/konva/). Rebuild: node build.mjs (see packages/dsh-canvas/README.md). Never published, and never shipped: a distribution carries lib/vendor/, and this folder is not part of the package's `files` list - the same bargain the vendored fonts make. There is deliberately no package-lock.json and no node_modules: build.mjs reads the artifact straight out of the pinned npm TARBALL, so vendoring needs no install step and no dependency tree.
